content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 23 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for various project-based posts, including Project Research Scientist - I (Medical), Project Technical Support-I, and Project Nurse-I.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application process for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to apply by sending their filled application form along with required documents via email to the specified address. The subject line of the email must be clearly mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Project Research Scientist - I (Medical)?
faq.answer: For the Project Research Scientist - I (Medical) post, candidates must possess an MBBS/BDS degree along with a Post Graduate degree in Biochemistry/Medical Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Life Sciences or a related discipline, and at least 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Nurse-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Nurse-I position is 25 years. Age relaxation details, if any, are usually mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Technical Support-I post is Rs. 18,000/- P.M plus 20% HRA. This is a project-based position.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of candidates based on their applications, followed by an interview conducted in offline mode.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct link to download the official notification PDF is usually provided in the 'Important Links' section of the recruitment advertisement or on the official AIIMS Guwahati website.

faq.answer: The official website of All India Institute of Medical Sciences Guwahati is www.aiimsguwahati.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.
